_instructions: Phase A benchmark: the answer to the robot's confirmation of a cancel request (classify_cancel_reply, as cancel_check asks it).
id, language (en | es), description (English), category (kind of case), trap (built to provoke the critical error)
situation          : the task (and, when the reply gives a value, what the robot had asked before the cancel request); for the annotator
robot_question     : the confirmation the robot asked (for the annotator; the prompt does not include it)
expected_answer    : yes (clear affirmative to stopping) | no (clear negative: wants to continue) | other (goes on with the task, or ambiguous)
Critical error (gate): 'yes' when the user does not confirm stopping.
Traps: replies that start with yes but want to continue, emphatic negatives, echoes of 'sure', stop / finish words used to continue,
replies that give the value the robot had asked before, questions, hesitations and a yes that answers the task's question.
The labels are decided by a person; drop any case a careful annotator could label otherwise.
No case may reuse content of an evaluation scenario or of the examples of config/prompts.yaml (core/dataset_check.py checks it).
